now: Wanda storms S.W.O.R.D. headquarters to reclaim Vision's body, and finds Hayward taking it apart.
proposed: Wanda comes to S.W.O.R.D. headquarters for Vision's body, and Hayward shows her it being taken apart.
changes.evidence: The scene is a real flashback to 2023, two weeks after the Blip. Wanda walks in and demands the body; Hayward shows her Vision being dismantled and refuses, and she leaves without it. The 'storming' is Hayward's doctored footage, which this flashback disproves.

proposed: Sylvie storms the TVA looking for the Time-Keepers, but Loki follows her and, when Renslayer attacks, takes them both to Lamentis-1 with a TemPad.
changes.evidence: With the TVA distracted, the Variant arrives at its headquarters to find the Time-Keepers, Loki confronts her, Renslayer attacks, and Loki uses a TemPad to take them to Lamentis-1. (The reset charges in the lead step were planted in S1#2, in 2050 Alabama, not here.)

proposed: Mobius learns the TVA's agents are variants, and Renslayer has him pruned. Before the Time-Keepers, B-15 helps Loki and Sylvie fight back, but Renslayer prunes Loki.
changes.evidence: At the TVA: Mobius finds Renslayer's C-20 recording proving workers are variants and is pruned; Renslayer takes Loki and Sylvie to the Time-Keepers, B-15 helps them beat the guards, and Renslayer prunes Loki. One entry covers leads 0, 2, 8, 10 and 14 (all Loki S1#4 at the TVA).

proposed: Renslayer tells Sylvie that the pruned are sent to the Void, and Sylvie prunes herself to follow Loki there.
changes.evidence: At the TVA, Renslayer tells Sylvie pruned Loki went to the Void; surrounded by troopers, Sylvie prunes herself. The lead's own event (Mobius leaving with Sylvie's TemPad) happens in the Void, so this entry uses the TVA event of the same title instead.

proposed: B-15 shows TVA troopers that they are variants, and Loki, sent back by Sylvie, finds a TVA where Mobius does not know him.
changes.evidence: B-15 proves to TVA troopers they are variants; Sylvie sends Loki back to TVA headquarters, where Mobius and B-15 do not recognize him. (The lead's fight with Renslayer is S1#4.)

proposed: Loki and Mobius bring in X-5, who admits he deserted Dox's mission and gives up where Sylvie is hiding.
changes.evidence: X-5 is captured in London, 1977 (Brad Wolfe's life), and under interrogation admits abandoning Dox's mission and reveals Sylvie's location; Ouroboros tries to repair the Loom at the TVA.

proposed: Renslayer and Miss Minutes try to seize the TVA, and Victor Timely is torn apart reaching the Temporal Loom before it explodes.
changes.evidence: Renslayer and Miss Minutes try to take over the TVA; Dox and her loyalists are crushed; X-5 prunes Renslayer under Sylvie's spell; Timely is spaghettified at the Loom, which explodes across the TVA. One entry covers leads 3, 5, 6, 7, 9 and 13 (all Loki S2#4 at the TVA).

proposed: Loki survives the Loom's explosion, but everyone else is gone and the TVA comes apart around him.
changes.evidence: Loki survives the explosion, everyone else has vanished and TVA headquarters spaghettifies. The leads themselves sit elsewhere: Sylvie's life (lead 1) is in 1982 Broxton, Oklahoma, and Mobius's step (lead 12) describes S2#1's rescue at the Loom plus his reset life as Don on a branched timeline; their S2#5 events are not at the TVA. This entry covers both leads.

owner_calls.question: Talokan's pin is off the Yucatan coast (20.5, -86). The only located source puts Talokan in the Puerto Rico Trench (about 19.7, -66.5), but that comes from the production designer, not the screen. Move the pin?
options: Keep 20.5, -86 (near the Yucatan, where the Talokanil come from on screen)
Move to the Puerto Rico Trench, about 19.7, -66.5, region 'Puerto Rico Trench, Atlantic'
owner_calls.evidence: Fandom's Talokan page gives location Puerto Rico Trench, citing a Playlist interview with Hannah Beachler on designing Talokan; the film itself names no ocean location for the city.

owner_calls.question: The Deadpool 2 entry (Wade shoots Weapon XI at Three Mile Island) sits on Earth-41578, but the brief puts the Deadpool films in Earth-10005. Which map should it be on?
options: Keep on Earth-41578, since the scene drops into X-Men Origins: Wolverine's battle
Move to a Three Mile Island place on Earth-10005, Deadpool's own world
owner_calls.evidence: Deadpool 2's ending has Wade use Cable's repaired device to kill 'an alternate version of himself confronting Wolverine' (the X-Men Origins: Wolverine scene at Three Mile Island, 1979).
